sources.title: GitHub - NagaYu/customs: Declare what leaves. Ration what it costs ...
sources.snippet: Customs is a research prototype for routing across an on-device / private-cloud / external-cloud model hierarchy when the middle tier is free but rationed daily. It replaces the two habits that production systems currently reach for — escalate whenever the small model looks unsure, and redact personal data before you send it — with four mechanisms that measurably beat both.
